This '''mission''' was executed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to investigate the disappearance of the entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ova]]. His investigations led him to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where he managed to stop the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister clans]] from destroying [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with the [[Infinity Gate]].
